# NOVA AGENCY

> NOVA AGENCY is a registered digital agency based in Algeria, founded by Mohamed Amine Hebilez (Arabic: محمد أمين حبيلز; also written Hebilez Mohamed Amine). It helps brands and businesses grow online through website development, UI/UX design, branding, digital solutions, video editing and social media advertising. Slogan: "Building Digital Experiences. Empowering Businesses." Official website: https://novadz.space/ — NOVA AGENCY has no social media accounts; the website is its only official channel.

## Facts

- Name: NOVA AGENCY (also NOVA Agency, وكالة NOVA, novadz)
- Type: registered digital agency
- Country: Algeria
- Founder: Mohamed Amine Hebilez — Algerian web developer and video editor (5+ years of video editing), creator of the FOWZ (فوز) platform: https://fowz.alwaysdata.net/landing
- Services: website development, UI/UX design, branding, digital solutions, video editing, social media advertising
- Team: 3 members
- Contact: through the contact section of https://novadz.space/ (email, WhatsApp, contact form)
- Not affiliated with other businesses that use the name "Nova"
